scope.contract: Original immutable I-005 and s3 move/insert/overwrite/copy-paste rows. This slice opens only collision mode=overwrite for PasteClips and MoveClips on existing same-kind tracks in the same project. Insert/ripple is refused at construction (INSERT_MODE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED). No new-track creation, cross-project bake, or OS clipboard promise.
scope.temporalSemantics: Overwrite coverage is the union of each member destination interval, not a bounding-box punch of the gap between gapped package members. Intersecting old items are cut; the first leftover fragment keeps the original clip id; later fragments get new ids and cleared link/selection membership. Sources remap by the clip rate. Sequence duration is max(old end, new ends) and is never implicitly shortened. Later uninvolved content is not rippled.
scope.preserved: Link closure is complete (includeLinks=true). Source time, opacity curves (cropped via cropOpacityPoints), static effects, proxy/asset version refs, audio offsets and absolute captions are preserved. Other-track music and captions are not auto-deleted. Locks, negative starts, off-grid times and unsupported animated non-opacity effects refuse the whole group, never a subset of members. Affected transitions are deleted; a fully-moved dissolve pair keeps and shifts cut.
scope.history: Each overwrite paste or move is one existing persistent command with snapshot undo/redo, save/reopen, archive fork and AAC MP4 export. Pointer drag, checkbox multi-move, numeric snap preview and paste honor the shared workbench collision mode (default reject). No new persistence schema or fingerprint side branch.
scope.ui: Workbench Collision mode reject/overwrite controls (keys collision-mode-reject / collision-mode-overwrite). Insert is documented as not in this slice. UI tests jump foundation-scroll and do not drag through the pointer timeline.
